decision.summary: A co-occurring E-up/U-down excursion begins near index 605 and persists through 614 without reversal in the allowed context [570,650]; the absence of a clear return prevents confirmation as a temporary offset. The optional jump at index 600 is inconsistent with the observed onset (E jumps positive at 600 but rises only from 605 onward) and thus rejected.

intervals.observation: E-component shows a sustained step-like rise from ~index 605 to 614 (≈+2 MAD), while U-component drops sharply (~−4 MAD) over the same span; N remains noisy with no coherent counterpart. No return to pre-event levels is observed within allowed context (up to 650).
